def comps(g,val):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        for j,x in enumerate(row):
            if x==val and (i,j) not in seen:
                q=[(i,j)]; s={(i,j)}; cells=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<len(g) and 0<=nb<len(g[0]) and g[na][nb]==val and (na,nb) not in s:
                            q.append((na,nb)); s.add((na,nb))
                out.append(sorted(cells))
    return out
from collections import Counter

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load()
def comps(g):
    dom=max(set(v for row in g for v in row)-{0}, key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        for j,x in enumerate(row):
            if x==dom and (i,j) not in seen:
                q=[(i,j)]; s={(i,j)}; cs=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.pop(); cs.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                        if 0<=na<len(g) and 0<=nb<len(g[0]) and g[na][nb]==dom and (na,nb) not in s:
                            q.append((na,nb)); s.add((na,nb))
                out.append(sorted(cs))
    return out

def comps(g):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(len(g)):
        for j in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[i][j]!=0 and (i,j) not in seen:
                c=[]; stack=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); col=g[i][j]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); c.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        n=(a+da,b+db)
                        if 0<=n[0]<len(g) and 0<=n[1]<len(g[0]) and g[n[0]][n[1]]==col and n not in seen:
                            seen.add(n); stack.append(n)
                out.append((c,col))
    return out

import os,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(len(g)):
        for j in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[i][j]!=0 and (i,j) not in seen:
                c=[]; stack=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); col=g[i][j]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); c.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        n=(a+da,b+db)
                        if 0<=n[0]<len(g) and 0<=n[1]<len(g[0]) and g[n[0]][n[1]]==col and n not in seen:
                            seen.add(n); stack.append(n)
                out.append(c)
    return out
# Rule candidate: each big component is a NOISY copy of the same canonical shape.

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    o=G[name+' output']; g=G[name+' input']
    gs=comps(g); dh,dw=len(o),len(o[0])
    dots=[c[0] for c in gs if len(c)==1]
    bigs=[c for c in gs if len(c)>1]
    print('===',name,'dots:',sorted(dots),'big comps:')
    for c in bigs:
        r0=min(p[0] for p in c); c0=min(p[1] for p in c)
        h=max(p[0] for p in c)-r0+1; w=max(p[1] for p in c)-c0+1
        print('   TL',r0,c0,'bbox',h,w)
    # find which big comp's mask is EXACTLY the output under translation — check using only cells where the comp is nonzero mapping onto output nonzero
    for c in bigs:
        r0=min(p[0] for p in c); c0=min(p[1] for p in c)
        h=max(p[0] for p in c)-r0+1; w=max(p[1] for p in c)-c0+1
        mm=[[g[r0+a][c0+b] for b in range(w)] for a in range(h)]
        nz=sum(mm[a][b] for a in range(h) for b in range(w))
        offs=[(dy,dx) for dy in range(dh-h+1) for dx in range(dw-w+1)
              if sum(mm[a][b]==o[dy+a][dx+b] for a in range(h) for b in range(w))==nz]
        print('   exact-nz shifts:',offs)

def get_comps(g):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):

from collections import Counter
def get_comps(g):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                stack=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop()
                    if (y,x) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((y,x)); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        for dx in(-1,0,1):
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<len(g) and 0<=nx<len(g[0]) and g[ny][nx] and (ny,nx) not in seen: stack.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(comp)
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

    outm=[[v!=0 for v in row] for row in o]
    for A in cs:
        rs=[p[0] for p in A]; cc=[p[1] for p in A]
        r0=min(rs); c0=min(cc)
        h=max(rs)-r0+1; w=max(cc)-c0+1
        C=[[ti[r0+a][c0+b]!=0 for b in range(w)] for a in range(h)]
        # exhaustive translation search placing C inside out dims
        best=None

        # simpler: try every position, compute agreement of non-empty pattern (don't care about zeros of output?) 
        for dy in range(len(o)-h+1):

                best=(oksum,dy,dx) if best is None or oksum>best[0] else best
        ds=[a for a in range(h) for b in range(w) if C[a][b] and not best or True]
        print(f' TL({r0},{c0}) {h}x{w}: best alignment agree={best[0]}/{h*w} at shift({best[1]}, {best[2]})')
        break
